name: Continental Celts

attributes.attribute: could find the object of a curse

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The entry looks to a goddess of the Continental Celts. She is called Ads, by name. She was called the weaver of spells, a god of magic and of the Otherworld. As she who seeks out, she could find the object of any curse or of any blessing.

okr.objective: A Continental goddess named Ads is tied to magic and the Otherworld.
key_results: She was called the weaver of spells.
She governed magic and the Otherworld.
She could seek out the object of a curse or blessing.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
